items.q: What is UstaTop and how does it work?
items.a: UstaTop is a professional masters marketplace in Uzbekistan. A client creates an order, AI matches 3-5 best masters in 30 seconds. Client picks one, master arrives and does the job. Payment is held in escrow and released to the master after completion.

items.q: How much does the service cost?
items.a: Sign-up and ordering are free for clients. You only pay the job price. Masters pay a 10% commission per order (5% on Premium tier).

items.q: What if the master does a poor job?
items.a: Within the 30-day warranty, the master will fix it for free. If they refuse — escrow refunds you fully and the master is penalized in rating. After 3 lost disputes the master is removed from the platform.
Payme, Click, Uzcard and Humo cards, bank transfer and cash (only handed to the master).
Each master verifies passport via MyID.uz, uploads diploma/certificate, confirms phone and address. Over time, ratings and reviews accumulate — this determines the trust tier.
Currently active in Tashkent, Samarkand, Bukhara, Andijan, Fergana, Namangan, Karshi and Nukus. By end of 2026 we'll cover all 12 regions.
The site works on any device (PWA — you can install it on the home screen). Native iOS/Android app launches H2 2026.

items.q: What does it take to become a master?
items.a: 18+ age, a MyID.uz account, a relevant document (diploma or certificate) and a smartphone. Onboarding takes 15 minutes, verification within 24 hours.
